mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without requiring specific trigger conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 208.0 indicates accelerating inflation, triggering delayed Fed rate cuts and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 208.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad demand contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) delays Fed rate cuts, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days due to economic weakness.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO below 114.0 indicates manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as industrial output contraction pressures earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when INDPRO falls below 114.0.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained housing starts (HOUST) growth consistently predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days as housing activity signals strong consumer confidence.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST shows consecutive monthly growth.

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS growth above 100,000 signals robust labor market conditions, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as employment supports consumer spending.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS exceeds 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous HOUST and GDPC1 increases signal robust economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days as growth expectations boost equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and GDPC1 both increase from prior period
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and GDPC1 increase from prior periods.
